narrative: Today's CVEs supply the exact threat material a triage baseline would standardize around: the Langroid prompt-injection-to-RCE flaw (CVSS 9.8) and the actively exploited LiteLLM proxy injection share a remediation pattern - treat model-authored SQL as untrusted and enforce least-privilege, read-only-by-default roles. That recurring severity-and-fix shape is the structural force pushing federal, financial, and insurer triage toward a common standard.
remaining_gap: No named federal, financial-regulator, or insurer triage framework appeared; today's items are vendor advisories, not the baseline itself.
